0022600032.text: The Trail Blazers (6-1, first in the Northwest and first in the West, on a three-game win streak and 5-0 on the road) visit the Lakers (7-2, first in the Pacific and second in the West, also on a three-game streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, Portland's eighth of the season. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 136-129 win in Los Angeles on October 27, and it won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
